title: Gate Token (v2)
description: v2 contract for gate-decision authorization tokens (JWT claim set). Promotes function_id and content_hash to first-class top-level claims, per contracts/gate-token/spec.md v1's 'Forward plan' section. See v2/spec.md for the full rationale, the deprecated resource-claim compatibility form, and the tenant_id forward-compatibility plan. contracts/gate-token/schema.json (v1) is unchanged by this file and remains frozen exactly as published.

sub.description: Subject the token authorizes (agent_run_id or actor id).

exp.description: Expiry (Unix seconds). Bounds token validity — required for replay/window control.

jti.description: Unique token id — single-use/replay-prevention claim. A consuming resource server MUST track seen jti values within the token's validity window and reject reuse.

gate_decision_id.description: FK to Vault gate_decisions.id — binds this token to the specific gate decision and resource it authorizes, so it cannot be replayed against a different resource/decision.

function_id.description: Which governed capability this token authorizes. First-class in v2 (was packed into the v1 `resource` string as canonical JSON — see v1 spec.md's addendum and v2/spec.md's migration note).

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest (lowercase, 64 chars) of the exact bytes this token authorizes publishing. First-class in v2. A verifier MUST still recompute this hash over the raw bytes it is about to act on rather than trusting any caller-supplied or stored value — promoting the claim removes the byte-equality canonical-JSON re-parsing requirement, not the recompute-and-compare requirement.

resource.description: DEPRECATED v1-compatibility form. In v1 this optional field carried function_id/content_hash packed as canonical JSON. v2 issuers MUST NOT rely on this field to carry function_id/content_hash — both are now required top-level claims above. Retained as optional, unstructured, for a caller that wants an additional free-text resource-binding hint (e.g. campaign_id or asset_id) narrowing what gate_decision_id authorizes, exactly as in v1. A v2 verifier MUST NOT parse this field as canonical JSON or treat it as authoritative for function_id/content_hash.
